definitions.explanation: The state of flowers being fully open. Most commonly associated with cherry blossoms, but applies to any flowering plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満開|まんかい}だ。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満開|まんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The plum trees in the park have reached full bloom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満開|まんかい}になった。
examples.english: This year the cherry blossoms reached full bloom earlier than usual.

notes:
USAGE:
Used predicatively as {満開|まんかい}だ or with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ to indicate reaching full bloom. A key term during cherry blossom season, when weather forecasts track ⟦{開花|かいか}→開花：14525_kaika⟧ (first bloom) and {満開|まんかい} (full bloom) dates across the country.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満開|まんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to reach full bloom
- {満開|まんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach full bloom
- {満開|まんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧: cherry blossoms in full bloom
- {満開|まんかい}⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧: full bloom forecast
